name: Contractual annual leave hourly addition (OW)
authority: MOM Part-time employment: leave (https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/part-time-employment/leave), retrieved 2026-10-03: clear contractual annual-leave encash agreement, prohibited where work is at least five days and 30–34 hours weekly; hourly addition is annual leave hours divided by weekly hours times 52, multiplied by original hourly gross pay. CPF Board https://ask.gov.sg/cpf/questions/cm0f52l39035vpz7a3bwg3pre: OW must be wholly and exclusively for one calendar month and payable by the 14th of the following month. Explicit OW/AW class admission uses the actual signed payable clause; payment date is not payable date. Source-year quantity remains conserved against actual computed and consumed/reserved hourly entitlement.

admission.when: derived.subject.employment.type == "PART_TIME" && derived.subject.terms.ordinary_hours_per_week > 0.0 && derived.subject.terms.ordinary_hours_per_week < 35.0 && derived.subject.terms.working_days_per_week > 0.0 && !(derived.subject.terms.working_days_per_week >= 5.0 && derived.subject.terms.ordinary_hours_per_week >= 30.0 && derived.subject.terms.ordinary_hours_per_week <= 34.0) && derived.assignment.facts.source_weekly_hours == derived.subject.terms.ordinary_hours_per_week && derived.assignment.facts.source_weekly_hours > 0.0 && derived.assignment.facts.gross_rate_reference != "" && derived.assignment.facts.agreement_reference != "" && derived.assignment.facts.payable_reference != "" && derived.assignment.facts.source_start <= derived.assignment.event_date && derived.assignment.event_date <= derived.assignment.facts.source_end && derived.assignment.facts.agreed_on <= derived.assignment.event_date && derived.assignment.amount == rnd(derived.assignment.facts.relinquished_hours / (derived.assignment.facts.source_weekly_hours * 52.0) * derived.assignment.facts.source_gross_hourly, 0.01, "HALF_UP") && (derived.assignment.facts.payable_month_offset == 0.0 || (derived.assignment.facts.payable_month_offset == 1.0 && derived.assignment.facts.payable_basis == "DAY_OF_MONTH" && derived.assignment.facts.payable_day <= 14.0)) && (derived.subject.terms.comparable_full_time_presence == "ABSENT" || (derived.subject.terms.comparable_full_time_presence == "PRESENT" && derived.subject.terms.comparable_full_time_daily_hours > 0.0 && derived.subject.terms.comparable_full_time_weekly_hours >= 35.0 && derived.subject.terms.comparable_full_time_weekly_hours > derived.subject.terms.ordinary_hours_per_week)) && derived.assignment.facts.source_working_days == derived.subject.terms.working_days_per_week && derived.assignment.facts.source_working_days > 0.0
admission.message: Capture the qualifying signed original-year leave disposition, independently evidenced original gross hourly rate and actual monthly payable clause; correct the explicit OW/AW class. Changed weekly hours need a reconciled original-year basis.

statutory_admission.message: An hourly statutory base requires the actual untransformed contractual hourly cash rate.
Hourly allowance requires actual contractual weekly hours and days and a source-configured monthly conversion.
